lines.trans: How is the situation over in Studio Four?
Boss, everything is normal.
Are we really going to hand things over to them?
No handover; the staff from Units Three and Four stay under Unit One.
Is there any work that needs doing?

words.gram: Meaning: what are you doing / why.

lines.trans: Did you not say there was so much work here that you could not spare anyone?
The employee handbooks have already been handed out.
The reception-room carpet has already been washed.
The broken glass on the first floor and the lift buttons have all been fixed.
You would rather give me time off than let me go help Mr Chun Yuqiao?
His side is truly swamped and exhausted.
